name: XAUUSD_MOMENTUM_CONTINUATION_BOS_V5

entry_rules.hypothesis: Momentum continuation WITH the break (BOS) - ride the trend in the direction of the structure break, not fade it. V1-V4 all faded the break (mean-reversion); V5 tests the opposite.

bias_filters.trend_alignment: price > EMA50 for BUY, price < EMA50 for SELL

structure_trigger.freshness: detect FRESH BOS event on M5 frame within bos_lookback bars

momentum_confirmation.buy: close > prior_close AND close > prior_open (bullish continuation candle)
momentum_confirmation.sell: close < prior_close AND close < prior_open (bearish continuation candle)

description: V5: momentum continuation WITH the BOS break. Detects fresh BOS events on M5 (within 1-bar lookback), trades in the break direction with ADX>25 + EMA50 alignment + bullish/bearish continuation candle confirmation. Stop = 1.0x ATR, target = 2.5R.

research_results.hypothesis: Ride momentum WITH the BOS break direction (opposite of V1-V4 which faded it).

validation.note: 0 trades - structure events do not fire in val window

walk_forward.note: OOS trades = 0 in ALL windows - fresh BOS events on M5 are too sparse

research_results.conclusion: NO EDGE. Fresh-BOS approach fires rarely but win rate is 0-1% when it does. BOS/CHoCH structure events on M5 XAUUSD do not produce continuation momentum. 5 strategies tested (V1 trend-long, V2 trend-both, V3 MR-fade, V4 range-MR-fade, V5 momentum-continuation). ALL show PF=0.00 or below breakeven. The EMA/ADX/BOS structure logic does not generate edge on 2yr XAUUSD M5/M15 data in either direction (fade or ride). Need a fundamentally different approach.

notes: Research script: research/v5_momentum_continuation.py - no MT5 writes, no live trading, no fabrication. All numbers computed from db/trading.db (XAUUSD M15: 47398 bars, M5: 35797 bars). Broker timeframe offset UTC+3. M5 data covers ~6 months vs M15's ~2 years.
